card.text: Ice giant that spins on its side.

introduction.text: Uranus's axis is tilted about 98 degrees. Its atmosphere can be colder than Neptune's, down to 49 K.

normal.title: OPAL visible-color map
normal.summary: The north as observed in October 2025; the unseen south fades to a uniform Voyager-based color.

methane.title: OPAL FQ727N map
methane.summary: Reflectance at 727 nm in false color in the observed north; the south is a uniform fill.

near-infrared.title: OPAL F845M map
near-infrared.summary: 845 nm false-color reflectance for the north; the unseen south carries no measured detail.
